text:
Noah: quick design check — proposal: move the notification preview trigger from the right-hand actions into a compact inline spot under the channel chips so it stays visible when suppression flips. Thoughts? :eyes:
Anika: makes sense. main risk = row height creep in compact lists — we should prefer a micro-link + icon there.
Diego: agree micro-link. UX question: keep suppression toggle before or after the preview link in tab order? keyboard flow matters.
Sam: suppression should come before preview so keyboard users can toggle and then immediately preview results. that avoids extra tabbing.
Noah: ok suppression -> preview. For compact: "Preview recent alerts" becomes shorter to "Preview" with tooltip. For expanded: full "Preview recent alerts" button.
A11yBot: aria notes: use aria-haspopup="dialog" on the trigger and aria-expanded. When the preview loads update an aria-live="polite" region with "Preview updated: X results". Ensure the trigger has aria-label="Preview recent alerts for selected channels".
Anika: color contrast nit: the inline link must meet AA at small sizes. If we keep 12px text use stronger link token. Also ensure focus outline is visible in both themes.
Diego: implementation: lazy-load preview data on click for compact lists; cache last preview per rule for 30s and show a small cache indicator. Also surface when suppression reduces results: add "(suppressed)" in the preview header.
Sam: copy tweak: tooltip when suppression on: "Includes suppressed channels — preview may show fewer alerts." Keep tooltip copy short.
Noah: analytics: emit event preview_open with fields: rule_id, channels, suppressed (bool), source=compact|panel, cached (bool), result_count (int).
A11yBot: keyboard shortcut suggestion: offer a one-key shortcut (P) only after user has used preview once and opted in; show hint "Press P to open preview" after first use.
Anika: I'll update Figma with compact/expanded variants and the tooltip copy. Sam please add keyboard QA to the PR checklist.
Sam: will add tests for tab order, focus restore, and screenreader announcements.
Noah: thanks — I'll drop the mock and add a small note in the PR that color contrast and keyboard-only flow must be validated. :white_check_mark:
